In a pan over low heat, add the Baby Swiss cheese, American cheese, ketchup, mayonnaise, chili oil, Buldak sauce packet, Buldak seasoning packet, and chopped green onions. Stir everything together until the cheese melts and the mixture is smooth. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy and well combined. Add the partially cooked noodles and toss to coat. POV: You promised yourself you’d eat healthy then it’s 2 AM 🌚🍜  Creamy Buldak Pork & Sausage Ramen 🌶️🍜 Ingredients 1 pack Buldak Carbonara noodles 1 pack thin rolled pork slices (Asian-style) 2 hot dogs or sausages, sliced 1 tbsp chili oil (plus extra for drizzling) 2 tbsp ketchup 2 tbsp Kewpie mayonnaise 1 Buldak sauce packet 1 Buldak seasoning powder packet 2 green onions, chopped (divided) 1½ cups shredded mozzarella cheese ½ cup heavy cream 1 fried egg Instructions Add the rolled pork slices, sliced sausages, and 1 tbsp chili oil to a pan. Cook over medium heat until the pork is fully cooked and lightly browned. Remove everything from the pan and set aside. Boil the Buldak noodles until about halfway cooked. Drain and set aside. Using the same pan, add the ketchup, Kewpie mayonnaise, Buldak sauce, Buldak seasoning powder, and half of the chopped green onions. Stir until well combined. Add the shredded mozzarella cheese and heavy cream. Mix until the cheese has melted into a smooth, creamy sauce. Add the half-cooked noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with the cooked rolled pork, sliced sausages, and a fried egg. Finish with a drizzle of chili oil and the remaining chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy!  . #buldak #buldakramen #eat #food #cook
